children: AI-powered travel platform's fiscal Q2 revenue grew 35% yr/yr to $233 mln
Company posted non-GAAP net income, reversing a non-GAAP net loss a year earlier
Navan raised full-year 2027 revenue outlook and completed two acquisitions to expand platform
Raises FY2027 revenue outlook to $927-$933 million but Q3 guidance implies growth slowing to 30% from 35% in Q2
Company expects Q3 revenue of $253-$255 mln, up 30% year-over-year at midpoint
Navan sees FY 2027 non-GAAP income from operations of $82-$86 mln, operating margin 9%
GROSS BOOKING VOLUME - Total GBV rose 45% yr/yr to over $3 bln, driven by new customers, ramping cohorts, and expansion of installed base
ENTERPRISE CUSTOMER GROWTH - Navan cited continued momentum in the enterprise market, adding clients such as Cummins, Enbridge, and Ingersoll Rand
AI PLATFORM ADOPTION - Over 50% of AI calls now run on Navan's proprietary models, with its AI support agent handling about 60% of customer interactions
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 15 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Navan, Inc. is $30.00, about 12.6% above its September 8 closing price of $26.64
